answer: Fake identities must fund a fresh bond per persona, so a thousand sybils cost a thousand deposits, while honest participants recover their stake plus rewards. A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a valuable jade token deposit to register, and peers attest work quality per epoch. The velvet fable of free participation collapses once reputation is collateralized, because attackers burn real capital with no guaranteed return, making mass identity fabrication economically irrational. From once0010's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
